meta.name: alfworld-receptacle-preparer
meta.description: This skill verifies and prepares a target receptacle for receiving an object. It is triggered before placing an item into a receptacle (e.g., a garbage can) to ensure the receptacle is accessible and suitable. The skill involves navigating to the receptacle, observing its state (e.g., open/closed, occupied), and performing any necessary preparatory actions like opening it, resulting in a ready-to-use target location.

copy.tagline: 检查并准备容器以接收物品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在放置物品前确保容器可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and prepare a receptacle for receiving an object
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure a receptacle is ready before placing an item

howto.what: 当Claude需要把物品放入某个容器（如垃圾桶）时，它会在放入前先走到容器旁，观察它是否开着、有没有被占用，如果关着就打开，确保容器已准备就绪，然后再进行放置操作。
howto.when: 当你的指令要求Claude将物体放入某个容器中时（例如“把苹果放在碗里”），这个技能就会先触发，检查并准备好目标容器。

say.text: 检查一下垃圾桶是不是开着的。
say.note: 他会先走到垃圾桶旁观察状态。

say.text: 帮我看看桌子能不能放东西。
say.note: 他会检查桌子是否可访问。

say.text: 先确认回收箱已打开，再放瓶子。
say.note: 他会先打开回收箱，再执行放入动作。

howto.what_en: When Claude needs to place an object into a receptacle (e.g., a garbage can), it will first navigate to the receptacle, check if it is open/closed or occupied, and perform necessary actions like opening it, ensuring the receptacle is ready before placing.
howto.when_en: This skill triggers before placing an object into a receptacle, such as when instructed to 'put X in/on Y'. It verifies and prepares the target receptacle.

say_en.text: Check if the trash can is open.
say_en.note: It will go to the trash can and observe its state.

say_en.text: See if the table is ready for items.
say_en.note: It will check the table's accessibility.

say_en.text: Make sure the bin is open before placing the bottle.
say_en.note: It will open the bin first.
